about: Cookies register for www.claire-tian.com: every cookie and every item the site stores in a visitor's browser, plus the outside services a page load reaches. Logan 2026-11-28 07:03Z: "create a cookies register". tools/weekly_report.py checks the site's scripts against it every week and lists anything not registered as an issue. Change it in the same PR as the code.

storage.name: ct-notrack
storage.purpose: switches the visitor log off for this browser (opening any page with ?notrack; ?track removes it)
storage.kept: until removed with ?track or the browser's site data is cleared

storage.name: photo-list
storage.purpose: remembers the list of photos while a tab is open so pages load faster

third_parties.name: GitHub Pages
third_parties.receives: ip address, browser details (as any web host)

third_parties.name: Supabase
third_parties.receives: ip address, browser details, the visit record

third_parties.name: ipinfo.io
third_parties.what: country and network of an ip address, once per address (only when the IPINFO_TOKEN secret is set)
